notes.title: OVERALL THE BALL IS ON KICKSTARTER – WE NEED YOU!
notes.content: [h2]🎉 [b][u]IT’S LIVE! OVERALL THE BALL is now on KICKSTARTER![/u][/b] 🎉  [/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993777/68ba3664746d2d00cd99dfd24177d93615c5add9.png"][/img][/p][p]And we [b]need your help to take it to the next level![/b] 💪[/p][p]After months of passion, hard work, and laughter (and way too many "one more bug fix" nights), our [b]chaotic, stylish party fighter[/b] is finally ready to step into the spotlight.
